description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Language' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup' namespace. The class manages language selection and loading mechanisms for the admin section of the OpenCart platform, including setting default language, handling cookie-based language preferences, and loading language files.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Handles language selection, loading language files, and setting language preferences in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes language settings by loading available languages, establishing default language, and handling language preference from cookies or configuration.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Fills the language with default values after route execution, ensuring the correct language files are loaded based on route, prefix, and language code.
